title: ClickHouse table schema changes must be updated in HCL, generated goldens/SQL, Python definition, snapshot and migration together
answers: What files change when I add a column or index to a ClickHouse table like metrics4_samples?
Adding a ClickHouse index to a logs table
Which generated HCL goldens and SQL need updating for a schema change?
body:
Adding columns/indexes to a logs-role ClickHouse table touched all of these in one PR:
- Source HCL: posthog/clickhouse/hcl/roles/logs/metrics/metrics4.hcl
- Goldens: posthog/clickhouse/hcl/golden/{dev,prod-us,prod-eu,local-multi}/logs.hcl and golden/local-single/all.hcl
- Generated SQL: posthog/clickhouse/hcl/sql/{dev,prod-us,prod-eu,local-multi}/logs.sql and sql/local-single/all.sql
- Python table definition: posthog/clickhouse/metrics/metrics4.py:METRICS4_SAMPLES_TABLE_SQL
- Snapshot: posthog/clickhouse/test/__snapshots__/test_schema.ambr (two CREATE TABLE occurrences)
- New migration in posthog/clickhouse/migrations/ plus bump of max_migration.txt
Verify with `bash posthog/clickhouse/hcl/diff.sh`, `gen-golden.sh`, `gen-sql.sh`, `check.sh` (goldens must match every node, SQL must be fresh). Skipping any one leaves drift between HCL, Python and the migration.
applies: ClickHouse schema changes to tables managed via posthog/clickhouse/hcl (logs role, metrics4_samples)

Where are all the places a table definition needs updating
search: ClickHouse table schema changes in the logs role must update the source HCL definition, all golden files (dev/prod-us/prod-eu/local-multi and local-single), generated SQL files, the Python table definition, test snapshots (two CREATE TABLE occurrences), and a new migration with bumped max_migration.txt simultaneously. Verify with bash scripts: diff.sh, gen-golden.sh, gen-sql.sh, check.sh to ensure goldens match every node and SQL is fresh. Skipping any single file leaves drift between HCL, Python definition, and the migration. Applies to tables in posthog/clickhouse/hcl (logs role, metrics4_samples) managed via HCL infrastructure. Pointers: metrics4.hcl, metrics4.py:METRICS4_SAMPLES_TABLE_SQL, test/__snapshots__/test_schema.ambr, migrations/, and verification scripts.
